definitions.gloss: in moderation; moderately; to a reasonable extent
definitions.explanation: Not going to extremes, keeping things balanced.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ほどほどに。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ほどほどに⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{休|やす}んで→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
ほどほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。

notes:
ほどほど derives from ⟦{程|ほど}→程：01724_hodo⟧ (extent, degree) reduplicated. It expresses the idea of keeping to a reasonable, balanced level — not too much, not too little.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ほどほどに: in moderation (adverb)
- ほどほどの〜: moderate, reasonable ~ (na-adjective modifying a noun)
- ほどほどに⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to keep it moderate
- ほどほどにしておく: to restrain oneself, to not overdo it

USAGE:
Often used when giving gentle advice or warnings:
- ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧はほどほどに: drink in moderation
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧もほどほどに: don't overwork
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧ものはほどほどに: go easy on sweets
ほどほど implies a positive view of moderation as wisdom. It often carries a gentle, advisory tone rather than a strict prohibition.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{適度|てきど}→適度：03441_tekido⟧に: moderately, appropriately (more formal)
- ⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧に: restrainedly, modestly
- ほどよく: just right, suitably (emphasizes finding the sweet spot)
